units.source_text: 约莫一星期之后，摄津的表兄给住在河内家的我挂来了电话，说是姐姐婆家的远亲举行葬礼，要我一定参加。

en.t: About a week later, my cousin from Settsu telephoned me at the house in Kawachi and said that a distant relative of my elder sister's husband's family was holding a funeral, and that I absolutely had to attend.

units.source_text: 据说，以前我家举行葬礼，那家也派人前来参加的。

en.t: He said that when our family had held a funeral before, that household had also sent someone to attend.

units.source_text: 我便同摄津的表兄乘火车前去。

en.t: So I went there by train with my cousin from Settsu.

units.source_text: 参加吊唁的人除丧主外，谁是家属，我弄不清楚。

en.t: Among the people who had come to offer condolences, apart from the chief mourner, I could not tell who belonged to the family.

units.source_text: 是谁故去，我也全然不知。

en.t: I did not even know at all who had died.

units.source_text: 表姐的家成了参加葬礼的人的休息场所，表姐家亲戚的房间则在另处。

en.t: My cousin's house had become a resting place for the people attending the funeral, while the room for her family's relatives was somewhere else.

units.source_text: 在这房间无人谈及故人的事。

en.t: In this room, no one spoke about the deceased.

units.source_text: 大家都只惦挂着天热和出殡的时间。

en.t: Everyone was concerned only with the heat and the time of the funeral procession.

units.source_text: 不时有人提问：是谁作古了，享年多大呢？

en.t: From time to time someone would ask: who was it that had died, and how old had they been?

units.source_text: 我继续对弈，等候着出殡。

en.t: I went on playing the board game while I waited for the coffin to be carried out.
